pages.text: Takes the position of an energy-storing block and returns two numbers: the current energy stored and the maximum energy capacity.$(br2)Think of it as a magical voltmeter that speaks in FE units. Perfect for checking if your contraptions are hungry for more power or if they're already stuffed to the brim with electrical goodness.

pages.title: Usage Notes
pages.text: $(li)Returns null if the target block has no energy capability$(li)Current energy is always less than or equal to max energy$(li)Great for automated systems that need to monitor power levels$(li)Some machines may have multiple energy storage types - this reads Forge Energy$(br2)Pro tip: Use this with conditional casting to create smart power management systems!
